sloka: भवन्तम् सर्व भूतानाम् शरण्यम् शरणम् गतः ।परित्यक्ता मया लंका मित्राणि च धनानि च ॥६-१९-५॥।।
transliteration: bhavantam sarva bhūtānām śaraṇyam śaraṇam gataḥ ।parityaktā mayā laṁkā mitrāṇi ca dhanāni ca ॥6-19-5॥।।

translations.english: "Let this Rakshasa (night ranger) be a wicked one or not a wicked one, what have we to worry about such a person? He has come here abandoned by his brother and who will not send away such a person? Who will not do so?"
